summary: The patch addresses the issue of InheritDocstrings not working for properties by modifying the condition to include properties. However, it lacks additional tests and documentation.

issues.description: There are no new tests added to verify the fix specifically for properties. Additional tests should be included to ensure the functionality works as expected.
The change modifies the behavior of the InheritDocstrings metaclass, but there is no update to the docstring or comments explaining this modification.
